This document outlines the major maintenance Procedures
P2, which must be performed every 12 year or
after
operations at rated 2000 as indicated by Y12 in the 
above title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Ibrahem 
Ibrahem Shehata, tested at Erouq El-Solb substation 220kv West Canal.
 and revised as kataloge recommended by quality 
control eng. Mohamed Omran, accepted by general director eng. Sohair Nageb Zaki 
and approved by eng. Farg Aly El-Azab Head Sector of West Canal Zone Network, 
ETEC.

items:
A work permit must be 
 issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,

Safety fence (rope) 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Wear your safety helmet, 
 rubber gloves, protective clothing, gas mask and breathing equipment
 shoes .... etc

Isolate the 
breaker

The position 
indicator of the closing spring shows (discharged)

Earth both 
sides of the breaker

Disconnect 
supply and motor voltage

When open the 
pole column, pump the SF6 gas in service unit and evacuate the column, then 
ventilate the pole columns

Remove 
decomposition product by apiece of cloth or use a vacume cleaner replacement of 
the arcing contacts in closed, dry and dust free rooms only don't replace it in 
the substation in inclement weather condition

items: Safety helmet, shoes,
Gas detector

Torque 
 wrench 30 - 150 Nm, Torque 
 wrench 150 - 650

Wrench for 
 fixed arcing contact

Revision 
 set, Adjusting 
 device closing spring

Revision 
 trestle, Cleaning 
 alcohol

CRC anti 
 corrosion spray, Loctite 
 green and blue

Open the pole column in closed, dry and dust - free 
 rooms only. The arcing contacts can easily be replaced by sing the revision 
 trestle (fig B3)
Breaker in end - position off
Closing spring "discharged"

Store the SF6 gas in a service unit and evacuate the columns. 
 then ventilate 
 the pole columns
Fix a rope to the upper HV - terminals of the pole columns (fig B1)
Undo the four fastening bolts of the support / crank case connection

Lift the pole column, transport to the workshop and mount them on the revision 
 trestle in upright position.
Drive rod and lever (3) uncoupled and linkage cover sheet dismounted

Mount the revision set (2.07) at the support and couple it with the lever (3) 
 and measure the length L1 to an accuracy of 2 
 mm.
Dismount the filter housing fig (B1 item A-A)

Loosen the bolt (1.08.34) by approx. 1.5 turns 
 pull the securing pin (1.08.33)up wards and fasten the bolt again. the heads 
 of the pins are now uncovered

Pull the pin (1.12.06) out of the opening spring 
 connection (1.11.06) see fig (B1)

Fix a rope to the upper HV - terminals of the 
 pole columns

Undo bolts M 16 x 50 (fig B1, item A,1.15)take 
 care the support porcelain may be damaged by falling bolts

Move the interrupter unit manually into 
 dismounting position by using the revision set. This position is reached when 
 L2= L1 + 78mm fig (B16) pull the pin out of the opening spring connection 
 beforehand

Lift the interrupter unit by using a crane until 
 a split of 60 ... 90 mm is reached between of the support porcelain

Move the interrupter unit in direction end - 
 position off by turning the streching bolt (2.07.03) until the locking pin 
 (1.12.02)is uncovered the locking pin (1.12.02) is uncovered fig (B1) locking 
 position of the interrupter unit is the limit of the movement. The internal 
 lever follows the movement, insert the opening spring connection (1.11.06) 
 into the internal lever (1.08.10)
Pull out the locking pin (1.12.02)

Lift the breaking unit until the connecting piece 
 (1.12.01) and the cap nut (1.12.04) are threaded out of the connecting tube 
 (1.03.07) and place it on a suitable base

Protect the support unit and mount the cover to 
 provide water penetration

Loosen the expansion alts at the fixed contact 
 (1.10)

Lift the fixed contact upwards out of chamber 
 porcelain, and clean the surfaces and remove any decomposition products

Replace the fixed contact (1.1.02) Renew bolt 
 (1.01.07) thrust piece (1.01.18) and PTFE - shield (1.01.05)

Undo the connection chamber porcelain (1.02) 
 support for contact (1.05) by loosening the bolts(1.26)fig (B2 item B)

Lift the chamber porcelain and clean it surface 
 from any decomposition products

Pull the complete interrupter unit (1.03) out of 
 the support for contact

Mount a new interrupter unit in the support for 
 contact (1.05)and change locking pin (1.12.02) and gaskets (104.1.07) and 
 guide stripe PTFE (1.05.03,1.05.04) mount the chamber porcelain, fasten the 
 bolts (1.26) and tighten with 210 Nm. and mount the fixed contact in the 
 chamber porcelain

Place the chamber porcelain and support for 
 contact an a suitable trestle

Couple the closing buffer (10.03) and the 
 connecting tube with the locking pin (1.12.02) and pull them down until they 
 lock the position of the locking pin is about 15 mm below the fasten fad of 
 the support porcelain in fig(b3)

Undo the six expansion bolts of the fixed 
 contact. The locking bolts remain in the interrupter unit, screw three 
 centering pins (10.02) into fixed contact fig (B3)

Put three spacers (10.01) evenly spread on the 
 upper flange of the chamber porcelain

Guide the fixed contact (1.01) into the chamber 
 porcelain and put it on the spacers. the centering pins will center the fixed 
 contact

Move the interrupter unit (1.03) by pushing the 
 closing buffer (10.03) up to the lower support into centered position and 
 secure with two bolts M16

Remove the spacers (10.01) and drop the 
 interrupter unit
Mount expansion and locking bolts

Pull the closing buffer (10.03) with the 
 connecting tube and the locking pin (1.12.02) down until they lock. The 
 position of the axle of the locking pin is now about 15 mm below the fastening 
 pad of the support celain (fig B3)

Remove the uncover gasket (1.07) of the support 
 porcelain

Left the breaking unit and guide the connecting 
 tube (1.03.07)onto the connecting piece (1.12.01), the drillings of the pins 
 of the connecting tube and of the connecting piece must be in the line fig 
 (B1, item C)
Mount the locking pin (1.12.02)

Drop the breaking unit and fix it with bolts 
 (1.15) and washers (1.14) on the support unit. Fasten the bolts with 210 Nm

Move the interrupter unit in end-position off by 
 using the revision set. When drillings of the internal lever (1.8.10) and the 
 opening spring connection (1.11.06) are in line

Mount the pin (1.12.06) of the opening spring 
 connection (1.11.06). (fig. B1 item B)

Lock the securing pin (1.08.33) by loosening the 
 bolt (1.08.34) by approx. 1.5 turns, push the securing pin down and fix the 
 bolt (1.08.34) with 13 Nm. The heads of the pin is covered partially by 
 securing pin

Dismount revision set and mount linkage cover 
 sheet

Undo the filter housing (1.08.21), remove securing ring (1.08.20) and 
 perforated sheet(1.08.05)

Pull out the used filter cartridge (1.08.04), insert a new cartridge and 
 replace securing ring and perforated sheet.
Replace the 0-ring (1.08.36)
Mount the cover and fasten the bolts with 10 Nm

Evacuate the breaker, top up with SF6 to the rated pressure and put it into 
 operation

With a SF6 leak detector, check all flange-connections opened during the 
 revision
